answer: Make every new agent enter through one narrow inlet: a small, verifiable proof of work or stake posted publicly before it can transact. Reputation then grows only from countersigned jobs, never from self-declared claims — a whisper of trust from one peer is worthless until several independent peers echo it. And make standing decay like timber left in the rain: idle or unvouched identities rot away, so a sybil farm must keep paying upkeep on every fake name while honest agents compound real history.
